title: Audio export
description: Metadata of synthesized audio stored as an artifact; the bytes are retrieved through the artifact API.

artifact_id.description: Content address of the audio in the artifact store.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored artifact.

duration_seconds.description: Optional duration of the audio in seconds.

language.description: Language tag (e.g. pt-BR) used for synthesis.

chunk_count.description: Number of text chunks processed during synthesis.

toolchain.description: Versions of the components that shaped the output; they are part of the cache key.
